# maatify/php-category

> Framework-neutral PHP contracts and MySQL storage for Category hierarchy,
> localized content, extensible fields, image roles, and assignments to Host media.

Use the Package Reference as the authority for the supported public runtime
contract. Use the guide and examples for installation and integration decisions.
Repository internals, tests, fixtures, contributor instructions, and engineering
standards are outside the supported consumer surface. Match the documentation
to the installed version. This artifact targets `v1.0.0-rc.2`. The README
describes the exact installation command and the publication state recorded
during preparation.

## Consumer documentation

- [README](README.md): Package summary, exact installation target, and public API overview.
- [Package Reference](CATEGORY_PACKAGE_REFERENCE.md): Authoritative behavior and complete public runtime inventory.
- [Usage Guide](docs/guides/USAGE_GUIDE.md): Host setup, capability map, and worked integration flows.
- [Examples](examples/): Executable Category workflow using the public API.
- [Schema notes](schema/README.md): MySQL prerequisites and the package schema.

## Release and support

- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Changes allocated to this artifact and past releases.
- [Security Policy](SECURITY.md): Support state and private reporting.
